profile.headline: System Software Engineer at Nvidia
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer currently working at Nvidia. I have a strong interest in IOT and connecting devices to the network. I have experience with a variety of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, and Java.

positions.title: Systems Design Engineer 4
positions.description:
●	Main point of contact for several factory test stations
●	Implemented application software for testing and calibrating various products (mainly focused on accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, and pressure)
●	Conducted data analysis on factory data using tools such as Numpy/Pandas and JMP

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
●	Worked on Cisco’s IOS including device drivers and kernel
●	Implemented different internet protocols for the bootloader (IPXE: HTTP, FTP, DHCP, etc.)
●	Designed PHY drivers, FPGA drivers for environmental control, I2C drivers, etc.
●	Configured BSPs for new boards and have done board bring-up
●	Developed automated unit test scripts in Python

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
●	Implemented Modbus/TCP communication protocol for a TI Stellaris microcontroller
●	​Programmed a TI Tiva microcontroller to have TCP/UDP capabilities and connectivity with a DSP
●	​Worked on improving user applications for both Windows and Android

positions.title: Embedded Developer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description:
●	Designed PCB breakout for a WIFI chip
●	​Programmed drivers for a gyroscope and a solar angle sensor

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

honors.title: Outstanding Graduating Senior for Academic Excellence in Computer Engineering
